turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How may I help you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I've had this ankle pain for the past day, and and it doesn't seem to be getting better. My right ankle looks swollen and it's bruised and is pretty painful so I just wanted to come here to check, check it out, see if I need any thing done to it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, absolutely, uh OK. So you said that this started yesterday. Was there any like trauma to the ankle or leg or did you have a fall or or some sort of injury?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah so I play rugby and I might have, so I fell during a tackle motion type thing and I fell on that leg and my leg, my foot kind of in, pointed inwards as I fell an I kind of fell on um on my ankle kind of just above, above my lateral side of the foot, so where that bony prominence is.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see and and your foot kind of it turned inwards when you fell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and was there pain immediately after the this incident?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, were you able to like walk off the field at all, or did you need to be carried? Or were you able to walk at any point after?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um so I can walk um, but. It is very painful and I'm putting a lot of weight on my left foot so it's almost like I'm hopping on my left foot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And and is the pain. Actually, so where is the pain specifically located on your foot or ankle?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So it's um specifically, it's on the like lateral malleolus area.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how would you describe the pain in terms of its character or quality, like is it sharp burning, stinging?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It feels sharp.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you feel the pain radiating anywhere else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh no, it's pretty much in that area just in the ankle area.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has there been anything you've tried to make the pain better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've tried some ibuprofen and some ice that seems to help temporarily, but it doesn't help with like like it's not permanent.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and. Has there been anything that's made it worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um just putting weight or like trying to bear any weight on that ankle has made it worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and what would you say the severity of the pain is on a scale of 10 to one, with 10 being the worst pain you've ever felt.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say it's like a 7 or 8.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you ever had a pain like this before to the ankle or ever injured your foot before?

turns.label: Patient

turns.text: OK, and have you had any sensory changes like changes your vision, hearing or even your sense of smell or sense of taste?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Patient

turns.text: Um no I've never, yeah I've never been hospitalized.

turns.text: OK, uh and. Alright, could you tell me a little bit about your living situation right now, like who you're living with and whereabouts?

turns.text: OK, and so I next wanted to move to the physical exam component and ask you to have a look at your ankles. And are you seeing any swelling or redness or discolouration?

turns.label: Clinician

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm and, uh if you press on areas of your of your ankle and foot, do you feel pain at the lateral malleolus or the medial malleolus?

turns.label: Clinician

turns.text: Um on the, no no pain at the top of my foot.

turns.text: OK, and how about on the like outside or lateral aspect of your foot you'll feel a kind of, it's a bony prominence that that sticks out at the base of the 5th or you're kind of last metatarsals is there any pain there?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and then how about any pains on that like medial side of your foot?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: On the medial side, no.

turns.label: Clinician

OK, so the that was everything that I wanted to ask and check today and based on these features it is starting like it could be either an ankle fracture or an ankle sprain. But because of the pin-point tenderness or that you're finding on the lateral side as well as some of the the inability to bear weight as you're describing it'll be important to get an X-Ray to make sure that there's not a fracture. Um and yeah, and if there is then it will be important to have some sort of air boot or casting so that to make sure that we're offloading the area for the bones to heal, but we'll see what the X-Ray shows.
